  Shikasta baazu shikasta pehlu
  Baaloṅ meiṅ safedi hai

  Dafn kaise hui zahra...

  Dafn kaise hui zahra...

  Dard itna tha ke karwat bhi na le paati thi
  Kab se soyi nahi zahra ye ali jaante hai
  Dafn kaise hui zahra...
  Khud to sab seh gayi seh na saki bete pe sitam
  Maut se kam na tha mohsin ki judaai ka gham
  Kaise ek maa ko sambhala ye ali jaante hai
  Dafn kaise hui zahra...

  Kitna yaad aate the baba ye ali jaante hai
  Dafn kaise hui zahra...

  Kitna ehsaan hai uska ye ali jaante hai
  Dafn kaise hui zahra...

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/dafn-kaise-hui.md')
before = p.read_bytes()
head, rest = before.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, source = rest.split('\\n---\\n', 1)
changes = {
'zahra':'Zahra', ' ali ':' Ali ', 'jaante hai\\n':'jaante haiṅ\\n',
'Haye':'Haaye', ' haye ':' haaye ', 'utaara':'utaare',
'hua jiska':'jis ka', 'Phasliyaṅ':'Pasliyaaṅ', 'janaza':'janaaza',
'Samne':'Saamne', 'amma ne tamacha':'amma tamaancha', 'bhoolega tamacha':'bhulega tamaancha',
'kuch na':'kuchh na', 'huwe':'hue', 'nihsan':'nishaaṅ',
'durra ye':'durra ya', ' maula ':' Maula ', 'tarha':'tarah',
'karrahti':'karhaati', 'soyi nahi ':'soyi nahiṅ ', 'seh na saki':'seh saki',
'mohsin':'Mohsin', ' maa ':' maaṅ ', 'sambhala':'sambhaala', ' bibi':' Bibi',
'wilayat':'wilaayat', 'hifazat':'hifaazat', 'gawahi':'gawaahi',
'uska':'us ka', 'Kitni mazlum':'Kitna mazlum', ' nabi ':' Nabi ',
'zishan chupa':'Zishan chhupa', 'uski':'us ki', 'kahaṅ marqad e Zahra':'kahaaṅ marqad-e-Zahra',
}
updated = roman + '\\n'
for old, new in changes.items():
    assert old in updated, old
    updated = updated.replace(old, new)
updated = updated.removesuffix('\\n')
assert len(updated.splitlines()) == len(roman.splitlines()) == len(source.strip().splitlines())
assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for c in updated)
p.write_bytes((head + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + updated + '\\n---\\n' + source).encode())
assert p.read_bytes().split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == before.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
